decisions.reason: As an incremental cardboard display variant very close to our core offer, it fits our existing design and production knowledge and can be improved through our in-house R&D.
The pegboard-back cardboard display stays within our established POS display capabilities, so early market feedback is interpretable and commercially usable for refinement.
This quarter-pallet cardboard display is squarely in our core competence set, making it a low-risk extension that a large specialist firm would normally retain.
Although a specific format variant, the eighth-pallet cardboard display remains closely related to our established knowledge base and service model, which supports continued learning and sales use.
The wooden display pallet is a more distant material and production step from our paper-based core, so despite our R&D it is harder to assimilate and less attractive in a flat market.
This media-oriented cardboard quarter-pallet display is still close to our core display expertise, and our integrated design, packing, and logistics capabilities make it worth continuing.
